# useAuth

React hook to access authentication state and methods when using `AuthProvider`.

## Signature

```typescript
const useAuth: () => {
  error: string | null;
  isAuthenticated: boolean;
  isReady: boolean;
  login: (options?: { returnTo?: string }) => Promise<void>;
  logout: () => Promise<void>;
  checkAuthStatus: () => Promise<AuthState>;
};
```

## Return Value

### `error`

- **Type:** `string | null`
- **Description:** Error message if authentication failed

### `isAuthenticated`

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Description:** Whether the user is currently authenticated

### `isReady`

- **Type:** `boolean`
- **Description:** Whether the initial auth check has completed. Always check this before rendering authenticated content to avoid flashing unauthenticated state.

### `login()`

- **Type:** `(options?: { returnTo?: string }) => Promise<void>`
- **Description:** Initiates the login process. Returns to the current path, query string, and hash after authentication by default. Pass `login({ returnTo: "/orders" })` to choose another same-origin destination. See [return to the current page](../concepts/authentication.md#return-to-the-current-page).

### `logout()`

- **Type:** `() => Promise<void>`
- **Description:** Logs out the current user. Clears tokens and session.

### `checkAuthStatus()`

- **Type:** `() => Promise<AuthState>`
- **Description:** Checks current auth status. Makes network request to verify and refresh tokens if needed.

## Usage

### Basic Authentication Flow

```typescript
import { Text, useAuth } from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

function MyComponent() {
  const { isAuthenticated, isReady, login, logout } = useAuth();

  if (!isReady) {
    return <div>Loading...</div>;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <button onClick={login}>Log In</button>;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <Text.p>You are logged in!</Text.p>
      <button onClick={logout}>Log Out</button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Protected Content

```typescript
function ProtectedPage() {
  const { isAuthenticated, isReady } = useAuth();

  if (!isReady) {
    return <Spinner />;
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated) {
    return <LoginPrompt />;
  }

  return <SecureContent />;
}
```

### Handle Auth Errors

```typescript
function AuthStatus() {
  const { isAuthenticated, error, login } = useAuth();

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div>
        <Text.p>Authentication failed: {error}</Text.p>
        <button onClick={login}>Retry</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return <div>Status: {isAuthenticated ? "Logged in" : "Logged out"}</div>;
}
```

## With AuthProvider

Create the client once at module scope, outside React rendering, then pass it to the provider:

```tsx
import {
  createAuthClient,
  AuthProvider,
  AppShell,
  SidebarLayout,
} from "@tailor-platform/app-shell";

const authClient = createAuthClient({
  clientId: "your-client-id",
  appUri: "https://your-app.erp.dev",
  redirectUri: "http://localhost:3000/callback",
});

function App() {
  return (
    <AuthProvider client={authClient} autoLogin={true}>
      <AppShell modules={modules}>
        <SidebarLayout />
      </AppShell>
    </AuthProvider>
  );
}
```
